facts.text: The hotel is in the downtown business district of Dhaka, the capital of Bangladesh.

facts.text: The hotel sits right next to Ramna Park and is near government offices and historic attractions.

facts.text: The hotel is at 1 Minto Road in Dhaka.

facts.text: Hazrat Shajalal International Airport is about 14.8 kilometers from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel has a millennium-modern look with a touch of local culture.
